Last vendor change that moved this answer: 1 Jun 2026, GitHub. Every Copilot plan billed in GitHub
AI credits, each token priced by model, replacing premium requests (which remain only on legacy
annual plans).
Without it: Claude Code on Anthropic API + Codex on ChatGPT Plus, $261.93.
Latest change to a plan in it: 14 Sep 2026, Anthropic. The promotion ended: standard weekly limits
in Claude Code are 25% higher than before it, which is one sixth (about 17%) less than during it.
Announced: 14 Oct 2026, OpenAI. GPT-5.5 retires from Codex on all plans.
¹ Anthropic publishes Claude plan allowances only as multiples of Pro per 5-hour session, plus a
weekly limit shared with Claude on the web; past them, extra usage is billed at API rates. "from"
is the fee alone.
² An estimate: Copilot keeps no local logs, so these are your Claude Code and Codex tokens at
GitHub's per-token rates; its agent would not use exactly these tokens. Included credits contain a
flex allotment GitHub says may change.
³ OpenAI does not state a price per credit for Plus or Pro; $0.04 is derived from its own figures
(2,500 credits for $100; 25 credits to the dollar on its Enterprise rate card).
Codex's readings are account-wide: Codex use on other machines and in the cloud counts in them.
Plan prices read 8 Oct 2026 from the vendors' pages; --json lists every source and date.
